noticeTitle: Rebind isn’t notarized by Apple yet
noticeDescription: Rebind is signed, but Apple has not notarized it. macOS may block the first launch because it cannot verify the app. If you trust the downloaded copy, use one of the options below to open it.
noticeQuote: “Apple could not verify “Rebind” is free of malware…”

settingsStep1: Try opening Rebind once, then dismiss the warning.
settingsStep3: Scroll to Security, choose Open Anyway and confirm.

questionsLead: Have another question? Open an issue on GitHub.
ctaLead: Free and open source for macOS 26 or later.
heroTitle: Make every key, button and tap
heroLead: Rebind remaps keys, mouse buttons and trackpad gestures to shortcuts and macOS actions, and keeps running quietly from the menu bar.
devicesTitle: One app for your input devices
devicesLead: Set up bindings for keyboard, mouse, built-in trackpad, Magic Trackpad and Magic Mouse. Devices in the same category share bindings.
experimental: Trackpad and Magic Mouse gestures are experimental. Some macOS gestures may respond at the same time.
actionsLead: Snap windows, switch Spaces, control sound, open apps, type saved text or run an Apple Shortcut. Search the list, no scripts needed.
privacyLead: Rebind needs Accessibility access and asks for anything else only when a feature uses it. It does not record what you type, sends no analytics and keeps settings in a local file. The only network request is a daily update check, which you can turn off.
installLead: Rebind is free. Download the DMG from GitHub Releases.
openNormally: Open Rebind and turn on Accessibility when it asks.
footerTagline: Remap keys, mouse buttons and trackpad gestures on macOS.

faqQ1: Why does macOS say it can’t verify Rebind?
faqA1: Rebind is signed and open source but isn’t notarized yet. Allow your downloaded copy once using either option in the installation guide above.
faqQ2: Does Rebind see what I type?
faqA2: Rebind checks key presses only to match your bindings. It doesn’t collect typed text, passwords or the clipboard. Input data stays on your Mac.
faqQ3: Can I remap Caps Lock or Fn?
faqA3: Not in the current version. Caps Lock, Fn/Globe, modifier-only triggers and left/right modifier distinctions aren’t supported.
faqQ4: Are trackpad and Magic Mouse gestures stable?
faqA4: They are experimental and rely on an undocumented macOS interface that may change with system updates. Some native gestures may also respond. Keyboard and conventional mouse bindings use separate input handling.
faqQ5: Does it work alongside Logi Options+?
faqA5: Rebind works with supported Logitech mice on its own. Logi Options+ or G HUB may take control of the mouse; Rebind shows a warning when either is running.
faqA6: With automatic checks on, Rebind uses Sparkle to check for signed updates once a day. You can also choose Check for Updates from the Rebind menu. Rebind asks before installing an update.
timingLead: Give a key or mouse button one action for a press, another for a double press and a third for a hold. The hold time is set per binding.
timingNote: Works the same for mouse buttons 3 and up.
mouseTitle: Hold a button, move the mouse
mouseLead: Each direction runs its own action, so one side button does four things. A modifier with the wheel works too: Control and scroll up can switch Spaces.
anyMouse: Any mouse: reverse vertical and horizontal scrolling separately, change the wheel speed and turn on smooth scrolling per mouse.
gesturesTitle: Taps the trackpad doesn’t use yet
gesturesLead: Choose a gesture from a short list: three- and four-finger taps, double taps, corner taps and multi-finger clicks on the built-in trackpad and Magic Trackpad, one- and two-finger taps on Magic Mouse. Hold a key during the gesture for a second action.
gesturesNote: Gestures rely on an undocumented macOS interface that may change with system updates. Some built-in gestures can respond at the same time.
profilesTitle: One setup for work, another for play
profilesLead: Keep up to 20 profiles and switch them from the menu bar or with a key. A binding works in every app or only in the app in front. Profiles never switch on their own.
excludedNote: Excluded apps: while a game, virtual machine or remote desktop is in front, Rebind can leave its bindings and scrolling alone.
menuTitle: Battery levels in the menu bar
menuLead: See the charge of connected mice and keyboards next to the profile switch and Pause. For Logitech keyboards, you can also set the lighting color, brightness and an idle timer.
lightingNote: Lighting lives in the Devices section. Other Logitech keyboards and mice with RGB lighting are supported experimentally.
emergencyNote: Works even while you edit or record a binding. You can also pause from the menu bar.
